`min_qty`/`target_qty`/`branch_id` renamed by InventoryRequestProfiles —

put.summary:
CAP-MOB-340-R02: the Owner API stock request — the item in the path,
`qty`/`note` renamed by InventoryRequestProfiles to `counted_quantity`/
`reason` — mapped to the same stock-count operation, so a different
quantity is settled as an adjustment movement with the note. The body
`idempotency_key` rule is unchanged (OWN-DEC-016 §3 is not yet agreed).
An empty `branch_id` is the context branch, else the company's main
branch. `unit` and `supplier_id` are accepted as the app sends them; the
count is the item's canonical-unit quantity and a stock count names no
supplier, so neither changes what is recorded

AiUsageStatus.title: AiUsageStatus

ApprovePricingRequest.description:
CAP-MOB-350-R02 (mobile §15 #3 `pricingApprove`): the finalize-price rules
for `POST pricing/{id}/approve`. The product reference is the `{id}` of the
path, never one from the body, so the body cannot name another pricing.
A path id that names no pricing is a 404 from the decision, not a field
error the app could not show against any input.
ApprovePricingRequest.title: ApprovePricingRequest

depreciation_as_of.description:
CAP-MOB-400-R01 (§26): the posted depreciation log (kept, never
replaced), and the date the accumulated figure stands at — the
end of the latest posted period (none posted: null).

AssignPlatformRoleRequest.description:
ADM-120-R05: the administrative user (by public reference) who receives an
existing administrative role.
AssignPlatformRoleRequest.title: AssignPlatformRoleRequest

tenant_id.description: Optional; when sent it must be the context tenant (CAP-ACX-110-R05).

company_id.description: The assignment target must be a company / branch of the context tenant.

branch_id.description: A branch of the requested company (the controller requires it to be the context company).

AssignmentScopeLevel.description: Scope level of a role assignment or permission override (ADR-005 AE-1): TENANT, COMPANY (= ALL_BRANCHES of that company) or BRANCH.
AssignmentScopeLevel.title: AssignmentScopeLevel

BookAccountantMeetingRequest.description:
Shape validation for BRD-ACC-F29-DESC07 / STEP06..08. Scope, assignment
and the future-time rule are enforced again in the action.
BookAccountantMeetingRequest.title: BookAccountantMeetingRequest

CancelOwnerMeetingRequest.description:
CAP-MOB-190-R01 (mobile §16 #6): the cancellation reason. The documented
request has no body, so the reason is optional; when sent it is stored and
audited with the cancellation.
CancelOwnerMeetingRequest.title: CancelOwnerMeetingRequest

CashFlowRole.description: CAP-FS-001 — cash-flow classification of chart-of-accounts accounts. CASH_EQUIVALENT marks the cash/bank accounts whose movements form the cash flows; the other roles classify the counterpart accounts of those movements (BRD-ACC-F10-OUT09 operating, OUT10 investing, OUT11 financing — CAP-FS-003). Unclassified counterparts are operating.
CashFlowRole.title: CashFlowRole

current_password.description:
CAP-MOB-330-R02: checked against the caller resolved for this
request (bearer token or session); the framework `current_password`
rule reads a guard provider the token guard does not have.

CollectSalesInvoiceRequest.description:
CAP-MOB-130-R04: the mobile §7.6 collect body (multipart) — the invoice is
named in the body (`invoice_id`), the proof file is optional. The amount
against the remaining, the invoice state and the branch scope are checked
by RecordCustomerCollectionAction. A retry with the same `Idempotency-Key`
header replays the recorded collection.
CollectSalesInvoiceRequest.title: CollectSalesInvoiceRequest

ConfirmExpenseClassificationRequest.description:
Accountant confirmation / correction of an expense classification
(BRD-ACC-F20-STEP12, EX43). Category and payment status are mandatory
(BRD-OWN-F14-RULE05), as are category and accounting account (BRD-ACC-F20-RULE07).
ConfirmExpenseClassificationRequest.title: ConfirmExpenseClassificationRequest

ConfirmSupplementalTaxDocumentRequest.description:
Owner's review and confirmation of a supplemental tax document (CAP-TAX-060,
BRD-OWN-F18-STEP05/STEP06). Invoice fields are optional overrides of the data
read from the file; their business validation (RULE03..RULE06, RULE10) runs in
the confirm action on the effective values. `version` guards a stale review.
ConfirmSupplementalTaxDocumentRequest.title: ConfirmSupplementalTaxDocumentRequest

CorrelationId.description: Correlation id of the request, for support and audit tracing.

CreateOrganizationUserRequest.description:
The invite body. CAP-MOB-170-R02: the mobile §22.1 body is accepted too —
`role_id` is the role reference, `phone` + `phone_code` the mobile number
(stored in the international form), and `all_branches` / `branch_ids` the
branch access (every branch when neither is sent).
CreateOrganizationUserRequest.title: CreateOrganizationUserRequest

CreateQuotationRequest.description:
CAP-MOB-140-R03 — the §7.4 invoice body without `type`. Authorization is
the endpoint's declared permission (enforcement point); `branch_id` is
checked against the context by the controller.
CreateQuotationRequest.title: CreateQuotationRequest

tenant_id.description: Optional; when sent it must be the context tenant (CAP-ACX-110-R05).

CustomizeMonthlyReportRequest.description:
CAP-MOB-200-R03: `{ hidden: [table key], extras: [extra key] }`. A missing
list means none (nothing hidden / no extra); unknown keys are refused.
CustomizeMonthlyReportRequest.title: CustomizeMonthlyReportRequest

ErrorEnvelope.description: Error envelope of every `api/*` error response (ADR-026 D-12 as amended by ADR-028 D-28.1).

message.description: Translated human message in the request language.

errors.description: Field errors keyed by field; empty when the error is not about input.

ExpenseStatus.description: Mirrors the expenses_status_check constraint of the canonical table (001140).
ExpenseStatus.title: ExpenseStatus

ExportVatReturnFileRequest.description:

`kind` (`return` · `invoices`) and `format` (`pdf` · `excel`); the invoices
file is one PDF, so `kind=invoices` with `format=excel` is refused.
ExportVatReturnFileRequest.title: ExportVatReturnFileRequest

FileExport.description: Payload of an export: the absolute URL of the generated file (ADR-028 MOB-010-R06).

final_price.description: BRD-OWN-F12-RULE10: greater than zero; DECIMAL(19,4) allows at most 15 integer digits.

GenerateMonthlyReportRequest.description:
Request shape of POST /monthly-reports. The month is mandatory
(BRD-ACC-F19-RULE02); the branch is optional (BRD-OWN-F28-RULE12/23).
Authorization and branch ownership are checked by the action.
GenerateMonthlyReportRequest.title: GenerateMonthlyReportRequest

amount.description: Validating decimal strings with a regex to ensure they are numeric before bcmath

owner_requests.description: CAP-MOB-230-R03: the owner's edit / cancel requests and their status.

MarkMonthlyReportReadyRequest.description:

accountant reviewed. Authorization and state are checked by the action.
MarkMonthlyReportReadyRequest.title: MarkMonthlyReportReadyRequest

Money.description: Decimal amount as a string (DECIMAL(19,4)); never a float.

NotificationKind.title: NotificationKind

OpenTaxPeriodRequest.description:
Period selection (BRD-OWN-F17-IN01 type + year, IN02 quarter for quarterly
periods, BRD-ACC-F27-DESC07 company). Authorization runs in the controller.
OpenTaxPeriodRequest.title: OpenTaxPeriodRequest

OperationType.description: Expense operation type (BRD-OWN-F14-DESC39): tax invoice, non-tax invoice or money transfer. Mirrors expenses_operation_type_check (001180).
OperationType.title: OperationType

PaginatedData.description: Payload of a paginated list: the collection (`items` unless the endpoint names it) and `meta`.

PaySupplierInvoiceRequest.description:
CAP-MOB-350-R01 (mobile §9 #7 `supplierPayInvoice`, multipart): the
documented body `invoice_id, amount, date, reference, proof (file)`. It
carries the same rules as RecordSupplierPaymentRequest under the documented
names: `date` → payment date, `reference` → payment reference, `proof` →
receipt file. The app sends no payment method: a supplier payment is a
bank transfer with its transfer proof (§9 payment rule), so a missing
`payment_method` is `bank_transfer`; one that is sent is kept.
PaySupplierInvoiceRequest.title: PaySupplierInvoiceRequest

employee_count.description:
CAP-PAY-040 payroll history (EX19 / EX23 / EX27 / EX29): employee
count, payment status and the payment date once it happened.

PostMovementRequest.description:

`company_id` must name the context company or be absent (ADR-026 D-10).
PostMovementRequest.title: PostMovementRequest

ProcessExternalSaleRequest.description:

ProcessExternalSaleRequest.title: ProcessExternalSaleRequest

proposed_margin_percent.description: Stored as a DECIMAL(9,6) fraction; a margin of 100% or more has no sale price.

PublishMonthlyReportRequest.description:

accountant sends to the owner. Authorization and state are checked by the

PublishMonthlyReportRequest.title: PublishMonthlyReportRequest

received_quantity.description: CAP-PUR-030 (OUT10): quantity actually received so far, derived from goods receipts.

cancel_reason.description: CAP-MOB-400-R01: the owner's reason of the cancel (status history).

expected_delivery_date.description: CAP-PUR-030 (IN05): expected supply date when known.

PurchaseOrderStatus.description: Purchase order lifecycle (BRD-OWN-F11 statuses; APPROVED is the spec §4 permissioned approval step before the owner's send action). Transitions are centralized here.
PurchaseOrderStatus.title: PurchaseOrderStatus

ReconciliationItemStatus.description: BRD-ACC-F18 reconciliation outcomes (OUT11/OUT12/OUT13): matched, amount difference, missing / unrecorded in the system, and corrected once an accountant's treatment leaves no residual difference (CAP-REC-020).
ReconciliationItemStatus.title: ReconciliationItemStatus

ReconciliationResolutionType.description: Supported treatments for a reconciliation difference (BRD-ACC-F18-STEP18..STEP20):  - LINK_SYSTEM_MOVEMENT: the movement was recorded (or amended) in its owning    module; link it and recalculate from its current amount.  - ACCOUNTING_CORRECTION: request a correcting journal through the Accounting    posting workflow; the item resolves only once that journal is posted.
ReconciliationResolutionType.title: ReconciliationResolutionType

RecordAccountantCommentaryRequest.description:

RecordAccountantCommentaryRequest.title: RecordAccountantCommentaryRequest

RecordCustomerCollectionRequest.description: Transport validation for recording a customer collection; business invariants stay in the action.
RecordCustomerCollectionRequest.title: RecordCustomerCollectionRequest

RecordStockCountRequest.description:

scope resolution and RecordStockCountAdjustmentAction.
RecordStockCountRequest.title: RecordStockCountRequest

RegistrationPaymentStatus.title: RegistrationPaymentStatus

RejectRegistrationPaymentRequest.description:

RejectSupplierPaymentProofRequest.description: CAP-MOB-120-R02: a pending payment proof is rejected with a reason.
